saveFirst: Save your changes before preparing a channel version.
formatHint: Formatting keeps your full text. Thread composition splits it into ordered posts; it does not summarize.
proofreadHint: Suggest mechanical spacing fixes without changing your source.
proofreadScope: This check covers repeated and trailing spaces in ordinary paragraphs. Code, quotations and marked-up text are protected. It does not check facts, grammar or spelling.
noSuggestions: No spacing suggestions for this revision.
startHint: Choose a format and prepare a version. Your source remains unchanged.
noPublication: Review and export here. Nothing is published to a platform.
draftNotice: Prepared from a saved revision · Awaiting review
staleNotice: The source has changed. This version remains available for reference; prepare a new version before reviewing or publishing.
copied: Copied. Destination editors may change formatting; images may need a separate upload.
clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable. Download the text or HTML instead.
issueOpaque: Unrecognized syntax is preserved as literal text. Check it before using this version.
issueUnsafeLink: A link uses an unsafe scheme and cannot be published.
issueExternalImage: An image is outside the managed asset library. It will not be fetched automatically.
issueStyle: This format cannot retain all of the original styling.
issueFlattened: A structured block has been converted to plain text. Review its layout.
issueThread: The full text has been split into a numbered thread.
issueMedia: Images need platform upload before this version can be published.
issueMarkdownLimit: Code and table content exceeds the X Article Markdown limit.
issuePostLimit: A post exceeds the platform limit or contains unsupported characters. Choose a thread or an Article.
invalidInput: Check the content format and required fields.
notFound: This document or channel version is no longer available.
staleSource: The document changed. Reload its latest revision and try again.
staleVariant: This version no longer matches the reviewed content or installed formatter. Prepare a new version.
reviewRequired: Review and acknowledge each conversion warning first.
blockedContent: Resolve the blocking content issues before marking this version as reviewed.
unsupportedMode: This operation only formats text. Rewriting needs a separate reviewed proposal.
exportTooLarge: This export exceeds the 64 MB limit. Reduce its image assets.
assetUnavailable: A referenced image is missing or does not belong to this document.
unavailable: The publishing workspace is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
crossOrigin: This request must come from the current PandaForce site.
threadTooLong: This text exceeds 100 posts. Choose an Article or prepare an excerpt explicitly.
issueUnresolvedLink: A relative link has no public destination yet. Its original target is retained as text.
issueImageLimit: A single Post supports up to four images. Choose Thread or Article to retain all images.
unknownTemplate: This skill is unavailable. Refresh the skill catalog.
invalidTemplate: This skill contains unsupported style settings.
staleTemplate: The skill version changed. Refresh the catalog and review the new version.
templateVersionHint: The selected skill version is frozen into the generated variant.
templateTextOnly: Posts and plain text keep their content structure; typography is used only in the HTML preview.
